name: ithacus
description: A pi agent framework that orchestrates coordinated sub-agent teams directly from the .pi/ithacus folder.
notes: Runtime depends ONLY on Node built-ins (node:sqlite, node:fs, node:path, node:os, node:child_process). TypeScript types are stripped natively by Node >= 22.6 (--experimental-strip-types); no tsc install required to run.

scripts.gate: npm run build && npm run lint && npm run guardrails && npm run semantic && npm run schema-health && npm run regression && npm test
